usage_chain: 用户选择合适的桌面位置
夹持式安装固定收纳系统
根据需求调整钉板和分区
使用挂钩、笔筒、文件夹等配件进行收纳
定期调整和清理收纳物品
storage_requirements: 可拆卸后占用较小空间

summary: The Modular Clamp-On Desk Organizer is well-suited for small space users who prioritize desk organization and flexibility. It fits well in single-user and home storage scenarios but is not suitable for car, travel, or outdoor camping due to its design and installation method. The product meets explicit needs for desk tidiness and easy installation while also addressing implicit needs for aesthetics and personalization. It is recommended for indoor use, avoiding high humidity and direct sunlight.
